_doc.purpose: App-specific patterns learned across runs. Makes repeat work cheap and consistent: the 3rd form with a mobile field reuses what runs 1 and 2 established, instead of re-deriving it.
_doc.authority: HINT ONLY — never an oracle. The Epic AC decides expected behaviour (AH Rule 19). A pattern only suggests WHICH cases to write and WHERE the element usually is.
_doc.staleness: AH Rule 30 applies. Every pattern carries lastVerified + source. Re-verify against live DOM before use; on mismatch, trust the DOM and update the pattern.
_doc.read_by: /test-case-creation (Step 3A — app-specific layer on top of the generic control matrix)

fieldPatterns.name: mobile-number
standardCases: above max length via pressSequentially (BVA, AH Rule 18)
fieldPatterns.notes: No HTML 'required' attribute — validation is JS-only on form submit. A live 'input' handler strips non-digits (value.replace(non-digit-regex, empty string)), so typed letters never reach the value. maxlength=10 caps typed length, so >10 must be attempted via pressSequentially/paste, not fill().

fieldPatterns.name: person-name

errorText.empty: Enter your first name | Enter your last name
errorText.invalid: <none observed — only an empty check exists>

standardCases: very long string (BVA — no maxlength set)
fieldPatterns.notes: No maxlength and no HTML 'required'. Validation is a JS .trim() emptiness check only — no character-class or length rule observed in the DOM.

uiConventions.name: inline-field-error
uiConventions.rule: Each field's error element id = field id + 'Err' (#firstNameErr, #lastNameErr, #mobileErr), class .error-msg. Toggled display:none -> block on submit; reset to none at the start of every submit.

uiConventions.name: transient-toast
uiConventions.rule: All transient feedback uses one shared div#toast.toast. Shown by adding class .show, auto-removed after 3000ms. No ARIA role, so it never appears in the accessibility snapshot.

uiConventions.name: invalid-field-highlight
uiConventions.rule: Failing inputs get class .input-error added alongside the error message; removed on next submit.

flowPatterns.name: successful-login
steps: fill #firstName, #lastName, #mobile with values passing JS validation
flowPatterns.endState: Toast '✅ OTP sent to +91 <mobile>' appears; sessionStorage['blinkitUser'] set to {firstName,lastName,mobile}; then window.location.href='blinkit-products.html' after a 1500ms setTimeout.
flowPatterns.notes: The redirect is delayed 1500ms — a URL assertion needs an explicit wait, not an immediate check. Session is in sessionStorage, NOT localStorage.

flowPatterns.name: empty-form-submit
flowPatterns.endState: All three error messages display; URL unchanged; no sessionStorage write; no navigation.

locatorStrategies.avoid: getByRole or getByText — div#toast has no ARIA role and is empty until shown, so it never appears in the accessibility snapshot
.error-msg — 3 matches on the login page, strict-mode violation
treating it as part of the mobile input — '+91' is static sibling text, not an input value

inconsistencies.observation: Error-element id suffix here is 'Err' (#mobileErr). The workspace KB records an earlier Blinkit page using the suffix 'Error' (#mobileError) for the same concept.
inconsistencies.note: Same-concept naming differing across pages. Report as a finding — never auto-normalise. Affects locator reuse across Blinkit specs.
